title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates E = 25 N/C from the projectile motion constraints.

title: Velocity at C
description: Essential: Correctly calculates v_C = 5 m/s using energy conservation or kinematics.

title: Potential energy at 4 m/s
description: Essential: Correctly calculates E_p = 4.5 × 10⁻⁴ J from total energy conservation.

title: Projectile motion analysis
description: Important: Applies kinematics to relate horizontal uniform motion and vertical accelerated motion under electric force.

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Important: Uses work-energy theorem or energy conservation to relate electric potential difference to kinetic energy change.

title: Geometry application
description: Important: Uses the quarter-circle geometry (R=0.5 m, OD=0.3 m) to find vertical displacement DC=0.4 m.

title: Acceleration from force
description: Optional: Correctly derives a = qE/m for the vertical motion.

title: Sign error in potential
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for electric potential energy change (e.g., forgetting negative charge or downward field direction).

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Fails to maintain consistent SI units throughout calculations, leading to incorrect numerical results.
